violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of soil residue and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Unit cleaned and sanitized during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026

The walls and conduit line in the walk-in cooler have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/25/2026

Inspector observed an access wall, located in the dry storage room, lacking a protective covering or similar alternative. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026

Sausages were observed held at 106 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2025

Deli meat (ham), eggs, cheese, chicken salad were observed held between 47-71 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC disposed of ham and other items were placed in cooler unit for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2025
The ceiling in the back prep area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2025
Outside dumpster area observed with furniture, wood pallets, and other debris. Refuse areas must be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean,. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2024
